sections.content_text: Section 39 - Limitation of Approval of Expenditure (1) In respect of any such expenditure to which tax is deductable at source, if the tax is not deducted or collected at source, or if the tax deducted or collected is not duly deposited in favor of the Government in accordance with the provisions of this Act, such expenditure shall not be allowable as expenditure under this Chapter. (2) In case of partial rent of the property, expenses shall be allowable at the rate proportionate against the partial rent. (3) Where a property is rented for part of the income year, the expenditure shall be admissible at the rate proportionate to the period of rental. Moreover, as per
